claims.claim: Mosaic maintained a $0.22 quarterly dividend in August 2026, while earlier extending Brazilian phosphate production curtailments because of sharply higher sulfur prices.

factors.name: crop-nutrient essentiality versus input-cost pressure
factors.basis: The business supplies essential potash/phosphate inputs, but sulfur-cost inflation was severe enough to curtail SSP production in Brazil.

risks.risk: Sulfur and other input-cost volatility can impair phosphate economics and utilization.

unknowns.unknown: These sources do not establish current fertilizer pricing, volume or full-quarter profitability.

claims.claim: Mosaic's January curtailment decision shows management responding operationally to adverse sulfur economics rather than maintaining production regardless of margin conditions.

factors.name: operational discipline
factors.basis: Curtailment can protect economics but also signals real cost pressure and lost production opportunity.

risks.risk: Persistent sulfur inflation could keep assets curtailed or pressure margins after restart.

unknowns.unknown: Restart timing and realized post-curtailment economics are not established here.
